reuse.why: Reuses refuseIfAlreadyLinked, findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and getServer, and extracts the copied link and download bodies into shared helpers that Fintegra and the existing providers all call.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a sixth copy of the link and transaction-download code, it folds the existing copies into saveLinkedAccount, linkProviderAccount and downloadProviderTransactions.

placement.why: Linking in accounts/app.ts, downloads and balance handling in accounts/sync.ts, the base path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching the other providers.

scope.why: The request was server-side only; the change also refactors every existing provider's link path and touches two desktop-client files (the latter forced by Record<BankSyncProviders> typing), a sizeable diff beyond adding Fintegra.

maintainability.why: Providers now share one save-account and one download path; the syncTables and fileId parameters keep existing per-provider differences explicit, though the helper set (saveLinkedAccount plus linkProviderAccount used by only three providers) is somewhat layered.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra links through refuseIfAlreadyLinked and the shared link/download helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies were replaced by calls to the extracted helpers.
